payload.definition: Humor that relies on specialized knowledge or in-group understanding of a particular field or community.
payload.inclusion_criteria: The joke's humor depends on familiarity with technical, professional, or cultural conventions of a specific domain.
examples: A SQL query walks into a bar, walks up to two tables and asks in a loud voice: 'Can I join you?'
Why did the developer go broke? Because he used up all his cache.
Why did the Python programmer go to therapy? He had too many issues to debug.
counter_examples: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything. (General wordplay, not domain-specific)
